description: This file contains functions for connecting to the Notesnook web extension API, managing tabs, and establishing communication channels with the extension's background scripts.

methods.name: connectApi
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Notesnook API by finding or opening relevant tabs and setting up communication.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Creates a promise that resolves after a specified timeout period.

methods.name: connectToTab
methods.description: Sets up a communication port with a specific browser tab and initializes the API connection.

methods.name: findNotesnookTabs
methods.description: Searches for existing Notesnook tabs or opens a new one if none are found and 'openNew' is true.
